lines.text: In the temple courts, the chief priests, scribes, and elders asked Jesus by what authority He did these things.
Jesus asked if John's baptism was from heaven or from men, and the leaders answered, "We do not know."
A man rented his vineyard to tenants, and they beat his servants and killed others when he sent them at harvest.
The owner sent his beloved son, but the tenants killed him and threw him out of the city.
Jesus said the rejected stone became the boundary stone, and the leaders left Him because they feared the crowd.
